text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon claims victory at the Arima 
Kinen. From eyes that once showed no 
emotion, tears of uncontainable joy now 
stream down her cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She had virtually no expectations placed 
on her over long distances. Her fierce 
struggle and resulting triumph brought 
courage and inspiration to many.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Holding that "pride" close to her heart... 
Today as well, Mihono Bourbon dashes 
forward to carry out the orders given to 
her—
